rules.name: Sankha Yoga

logic.expr:
# PyJHora/BVR-12: (L1 strong and L5/L6 in mutual kendras) OR
# (L1 and L10 together in a movable sign and L9 strong). PyJHora strong() uses
# house_strength >= FRIEND, not generic kendra/trikona strength.
l1, l5, l6, l9, l10 = [lord(h) for h in [1, 5, 6, 9, 10]]
if not all(p in ctx.planets for p in [l1, l5, l6, l9, l10]):
    False
else:
    l1h, l5h, l6h, l9h, l10h = [house_of(p) for p in [l1, l5, l6, l9, l10]]
    cond1 = strong(l1) and offset(l5h, l6h) in [0, 3, 6, 9] and offset(l6h, l5h) in [0, 3, 6, 9]
    cond2 = strong(l9) and house_of(l1) == house_of(l10) and movable_house(l1h)
    cond1 or cond2
